headword: in the hope of doing sth.
headline: in the hope of doing 表示怀着做某事的希望。
levelHint: 人教2019版高中必修三 Unit 4 · 先掌握教材常用义。
studyPlan: 先听读音，结合声音与拼写对照记忆。
按义项阅读例句，比较易混表达。

senses.title: 怀着做某事的希望
senses.usageNote: 介词短语，说明所期望的结果。

examples.en: They worked in the hope of finding an answer.
examples.zh: 他们努力工作，希望找到答案。

examples.en: She studied in the hope of becoming a scientist.
examples.zh: 她努力学习，希望成为科学家。

collocations.en: in the hope of finding an answer
in the hope of becoming a scientist

relatedExpressions.similarNote: 易混表达的区别见“近义与易混”。
relatedExpressions.contrastingNote: 具体关系应结合语境判断。

confusions.title: in the hope of doing 与 hope to do
confusions.summary: 希望做某事的两种表达。

example.en: She studied in the hope of passing the exam.
example.zh: 她努力学习，希望通过考试。

example.en: She hopes to pass the exam.

confusions.takeaway: in the hope of 后接名词或动词的 -ing 形式；hope to 后接动词原形。
